english.title: Postal service - obstruct business
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse,

(A)_[obstructed a person, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..), engaged in the business of a universal service provider in the execution of their duty in connection with the provision of a universal postal service]_
(B)_[obstructed, while inside a universal postal service post office or related premises, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), the course of business of a universal service provider]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 88(1) and (2) of the Postal Services Act 2000.
